LineItem.description: One priced line of a quote or receipt (spec 3.5 §7.5).

unitAmount.description: Unit price in the currency's minor units, from a signed release (A-I26).

Proof.description:
A detached JWS (spec 3.5 §7.2).

`jws` is the compact serialization with an empty payload; the signed payload is the JCS
form of the enclosing document without its `proof`.

kid.description: Key id of the signing key in `keys.json`.

RequesterId.description:
A verified requester's identifier (spec 3.5 §7.3).

| Method | Form |
|---|---|
| Web Bot Auth | `wba:{directory origin}#{key thumbprint}` |
| OAuth client credentials | `oauth:{issuer}#{client id}` |
| mTLS | `mtls:{base64url SHA-256 of the DER certificate}` |
| DID | the DID itself, `did:{method}:{id}` |
| API key | `key:{key id}` |

description:
A commerce receipt signed by a delegated receipt key so any agent verifies it
(spec 3.5 §7.5).

capability.description: Name of the capability the receipt is for: an order, booking or payment.

proof.description:
Detached JWS by a delegated `receipt` key over the JCS form of the receipt without
`proof`.

rail.description: The payment rail that settled it, such as `ap2`.

releaseSeq.description: The signed release whose prices the receipt uses (A-I26).

requester.description: The verified requester who paid or booked.

title: Receipt
